option_relations.rationale: Secukinumab-induced dermatomyositis exacerbation is a specific type of dermatomyositis flare, which is related to the patient's history of juvenile dermatomyositis
Dermatomyositis flare is a direct exacerbation of the patient's existing dermatomyositis condition
Drug-induced dermatomyositis-like reaction is not directly related to the patient's history of juvenile dermatomyositis
Dermatomyositis flare (amyopathic variant) is a specific type of dermatomyositis flare, which is related to the patient's history of juvenile dermatomyositis
